title: Document Not Recognized
message: Document not recognized in our database.
steps: 1. Check the code and key entry
2. Make sure the document is from SARI Système SARL
3. Do not make any payment if it's an invoice
4. Contact our support if in doubt
legal: Algerian legislation: Document forgery is punishable under Articles 214, 217 and 147 of the Algerian Penal Code.
